content: That "Eligible institutions" link demands a sign-in/sign-up, and is functionally useless to me as I don't have a ChatGPT account. I suspect it's a real link wrapped in OpenAI+ChatGPT tracking junk.

David Michael Roberts said:

I suspect it's a real link wrapped in OpenAI+ChatGPT tracking junk.

Thanks for the feedback.

Both links use the official chatgpt.com domain. When opened without being signed in, they redirect to the ChatGPT login or sign-up page.

https://chatgpt.com/sophia/eligible-institutions

https://chatgpt.com/sophia/verification

I’ll pass your feedback up the chain.
How is the list institutes determined? How is it that institutions like Max Planck Society and Helmholtz institutes get excluded for instance?
3 messages were moved here from #General announcements > OpenAI - Free frontier model access for 100,000 researchers by Chris Henson.
(messages moved to make this the discussion thread)
Same question. A lot of French top research institutions are not listed. Only 6 are.

6 Dutch universities are listed, including Leiden U and Utrecht U.
5 German universities are listed, including U of Bonn but not Heidelberg U.
Brazil is not even in the list :melt:

Thanks for the replies.

Note: I am not an OpenAI employee—just another user passing along the publicly available information.

I found this OpenAI Help Center article, which provides additional details:

https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001406-chatgpt-for-academic-researchers

From what I understand, applications are currently limited to researchers affiliated with institutions included on OpenAI’s eligibility list:

https://chatgpt.com/sophia/eligible-institutions

The article does not appear to describe a process for requesting that another institution be added to the list.

For problems with institutional verification, OpenAI recommends following the support instructions provided by SheerID first. If the issue remains unresolved, the next step is to contact OpenAI Support through the Help Center chat widget.

You could also start a topic on the OpenAI Community Forum to ask whether other researchers have encountered the same situation, but the forum is primarily a user community and cannot make eligibility decisions:

https://community.openai.com/

Note: I wrote the original text and used AI to help polish it.

https://chatgpt.com/sophia/eligible-institutions

requires signing up. Please actually check links are accessible in a private window before just reposting them.
It can't hurt to just copy/paste the list to Pastebin or something.
And put a date on it so it's clear this might change in the future
